title: Is RCRA’s waste and recycling system ready for a manufacturing boom?
summary: RCRA’s rollout was turbulent for manufacturers and environmental services providers. Hazardous waste and scrap companies are prepping for new demand, and awaiting details about EPA reform plans.

title: Collection worker injuries down, but landfill injuries up in 2025
summary: MRF workers experienced the highest illness rate of waste industry groups, but experienced fewer injuries compared to the previous year, according to annual data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

title: RCRA forced thousands of landfills to close. What happened to them?
summary: The federal law raised landfill standards but left it up to states to manage thousands of dumps closed without consistent standards. Now, many sites are left unmonitored despite public health risks.

title: Lessons from Washington’s PCR law, 3 years into enforcement
summary: The policy is successfully spurring the use of recycled plastic, even as thresholds and categories increase, said APR’s Kate Bailey. But some companies, such as Ocean Spray, continue to use no PCR and face penalties.

title: Agri-Cycle acquires 3 organics haulers, now servicing 30 states
summary: The private equity-backed organics hauler announced its first deals since entering the Closed Loop portfolio last year. They included companies based in Arkansas, Massachusetts and Rhode Island.

title: Nth Cycle prepares to go public as US critical minerals policy shifts
summary: CEO Megan O'Connor said the company's plans for both a black mass refining facility and licensing agreements for its refining tech are part of a larger plan to develop critical minerals infrastructure in the U.S.

title: BPI responds to organic compost coalition
summary: The Biodegradable Products Institute defended its petition to allow compostable packaging in organic agriculture, arguing opposition is driven by the waste industry’s use of other types of organic processing technologies.

title: Solar panel recycler expands into ‘epicenter’ for solar installations in California
summary: SPR says its new 42,000-square-foot facility brings its services to a region anticipated to have a wave of end-of-life panels soon. It also aims to meet the state's unique universal waste rules.

title: What is the US recycling rate? It’s hard to say.
summary: Understaffing, a lack of EPA action, inconsistent methodologies and differing definitions make the U.S. recycling rate hard to pin down. Here’s what’s behind the gaps.
